notes.title: Changelog 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Here are some demo updates:

[b]Added[/b]:
[list]
[*]Compendium where you can find essential information about studied birds
[*]Now you can skip the intro and cutscenes
[*]Inventory menu improvement
[/list]

[b]Fixed & Updated[/b]:
[list]
[*]Graphics enhancements
[*]Fixed using the camera without a lens
[*]Fixed typos and incorrect translations
[*]Adjusted player’s movement audio levels
[*]Updated the list of birds on the Observation Tower map
[*]Fixed tracking birds system on the wooden pier
[*]Fixed flashing Tracking Bar
[*]Fixed volume options
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO RELEASE
notes.notes:
From today you can play the demo version of the Birding Simulator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/632a57fe25615abd66546f6628cc73425242efdc.png[/img]

During the Steam Next Fest event, we will present the gameplay live, also some surprise awaits you. We encourage you to express your honest opinion on our Birding Discord and in the comments section! We hope that you will enjoy it!

PS
The schedule of Live Streams will be published tomorrow (22.02.2022).

[url=https://discord.gg/rSRrwbCCyH][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/1e646dd11ef2e25e948343ac2c0d54c4061c8a4a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Demo Release Date!
notes.notes:
It’s finally official!
On the pages of Steam Next Fest, you will have the opportunity to play the demo version of the Birding Simulator! We are glad that you will be able to test our production after all the hard work. A surprise and a couple of live streams await you during the Fest. We are waiting for your valuable feedback, and we will do our best to meet the expectations of the players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/8f436f11dadecf343e7377f86f2e40726bdb5b52.png[/img]

See you on 21/02/2022, and now we encourage you to visit our Discord also other Birding Simulator social media! We can not wait!

[url=https://discord.gg/rSRrwbCCyH][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747074/1e646dd11ef2e25e948343ac2c0d54c4061c8a4a.png[/img][/url]
